_comment: Engraphy hook wiring for Claude Code. Merge the `hooks` block into
project), and replace <ENGRAPHY> with the path to your checkout.
SessionStart resolves this checkout's scope against scope_list, then
injects the briefing and anything parked. It fires before any user message
exists, so the hinted half of the briefing runs on UserPromptSubmit
instead, once per session, where the first request is available as the
The hooks read only, and they read as you: the credential comes from this
machine's own engraphy registration in ~/.claude.json, so there is no
second copy of the token. ENGRAPHY_URL and ENGRAPHY_TOKEN override it.
Both exit 0 on every path, and a server that is down degrades the session
to the text-only contract. The timeouts are the outer guard: a hook that
exceeds one is killed, and the session carries on.
